item.title: [Tempering] The Case of the Missing Callback: Debugging STM32 ADC Injected Groups
item.description: A debugging log of a ‘Ghost Port’ issue during STM32 development. How a simple physical wiring mistake disguised itself as a complex toolchain failure when migrating from Keil to CLion.

item.title: [The Crucible] Embedded C Chronicles: Traps, Idioms, and Best Practices
item.description: A living collection of engineering wisdom and lessons learned from STM32 development. Covering topics from timer overflows to memory management.
